title: pvTemporalSnaptoTimeStep
body:
## pvTemporalSnaptoTimeStep

Makes a request for any time return the data of one of the input's stored time steps: SnapMode picks the nearest stored step (ParaView default), the last step at or below, or the first step at or above the requested time. Data are neither modified nor interpolated. Use it when scene times do not match the saved solver times exactly; use pvTemporalInterpolator to blend between steps instead.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Nearest can serve a requested time from a later stored step; use NextBelowOrEqual when results must never come from the future.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `TemporalSnaptoTimeStep`. Identity: `filters/TemporalSnapToTimeStep`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input of the filter. Accepted data: any data object (vtkDataObject). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":true,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataObject"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SnapMode` | Determine which time step to snap to. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Nearest","NextBelowOrEqual","NextAboveOrEqual"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Nearest"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json

  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvTemporalSnaptoTimeStep",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
